caption:
Tiramisu overnight oats
C: 58 | F: 12 | P: 18
Calories: 390 for this recipe
Serves 1 or 2 not starving people :) 

dessert for breakfast is always a good idea! keeps you full and fueled through your morning <3  i have an entire series of fun overnight oats recipe that help with meal prep for the week with lots of variety taken after my favorite desserts 

this incredible recipe has a creamy chocolate overnight oats recipe with a strong coffee flavour and a vanilla greek yogurt topping

Oat base:
60 grams oats 
1 tablespoon chia seeds
1 tablespoon cocoa powder
Pinch of salt
80 ml milk of choice
80 ml brewed black coffee
drop of vanilla extract
2-3 sachets monk fruit 

Creamy topping:
⅓ cup plain greek yogurt
½ teaspoon vanilla extract

Add ons: 1 scoop of unflavoured / chocolate / coffee protein powder
